fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and columns (e.g., "Round the Town" and "Looking Back"), with coverage of transportation and road/bridge construction delays in the Little River area near Seventy-ninth Street; discussion of University of Miami football coaching; a business feature on commercial use of water hyacinths for liquid fertilizer connected to a Fort Lauderdale operation; and extensive travel/tourism reporting on Nassau, Bahamas (including hospitality provided to visiting editors and promotion of steamship travel). Additional content includes humor and society-style items, advertisements, and an editorial on pricing and "constructive buying."
